purpose: Second twenty-entry batch; prioritize executable controls and fresh measurements before source-only bookkeeping. No whole-method exclusions from partial scope.

entries.claim: Keystream offset != 0. Round 8 states its sweep "assumes key index 0 aligns with the first rune of LP2 page 0"; B-04 covered 10 offsets, and R16-KDF and R16-PRNG covered offset 0 only. An author who enciphered LP1 first, skipped a file header, or started a generated pad mid-file is invisible to all of them. PARKED P-10 scores the omission at x8,192 for a modest range and notes it multiplies EVERY generator.

entries.claim: SEED residue - >2^32 seeds, other generators, nonzero keystream offset.

The LP2 keystream is a window of the Marsaglia Random Number CDROM (1995) - 634,124,288 bytes of published physical randomness with published SHA-256s. round17/SYNTHESIS.md named it the single live, reachable, unswept public-pad item and "the cheapest live item in this branch"; lane P2 found it, recorded its identifier and a verified HTTP 206, and left it unswept.

entries.claim: round17/lib_padsweep.dense_scan's English rune-index trigram prefilter — which selects which offsets ever reach the beam in EVERY dense pad sweep in this repository — retains a non-English true offset at a materially lower rate than an English one. round18/L7-redteam/RESULTS.md §A.7 names this quantity as never measured.

How much of the keystream OFFSET axis does this repository's published coverage actually touch? B-02 has carried status `open` / raw_status `scope-limited` since Round 10 with every field except `hypothesis` set to null.

The 1.2 GB of Marsaglia CDROM material in round18/L6-offset-marsaglia/data/ is byte-identical to the published archive. (Round 12 was burned twice: a silent 60.4% prefix of _560.00, and a 134-byte Git-LFS pointer standing in for DATA/560.13.)
Round 17 called the Marsaglia CDROM 'the cheapest live item in this branch' without ever costing it. How big is its offset space and what does finishing it cost?

PROPOSED CORRECTION to a status field, not a new experiment. round18/L6-offset-marsaglia/ledger.json sets B-02 status = `negative`. B-02's own hypothesis text is an AXIS ('keystream offset != 0'), and an axis is not made negative by a dense sweep of 220 mined configs plus 508/3,024 units of a fresh grid.

PROPOSED RESTATEMENT of an existing entry's coverage line, following round18/L7-A.8's precedent. R17-PUBLIC-PAD reports 14,522,916,046 offsets scored and 8,380,000,000 effective after prefilter survival. That survival was measured on ENGLISH plants only (L7-A.7), and L7-A.8 could only say the non-English coverage was 'unmeasured, not zero and not one'.

Every adjudication in this repository is decided by lp.score.Quadgram.score_norm, a quadgram model trained on four modern-orthography English books, against a fixed English band (>= -5.5). If the LP2 plaintext is not modern or archaic English, the CORRECT key is scored as noise and every published negative is conditional in a way no ledger entry states.

campaign14/REDTEAM-PROPOSALS.md (~line 155), queued and never run for the post-B6 sweeps: language-agnostic and non-English re-scoring of all sweep bests. Any archived 'null' whose decrypt scores high under Old English / Latin, or shows an elevated decrypt IoC.N, is a missed hit.

Round 10b lane B6 issued a binding handoff requirement - persist a language-agnostic statistic at sweep time, because retro-fitting is impossible once the decodes are thrown away. Later sweeps complied.

skipdecode.beam_decode admits a key skip only if EVERY skipped key position would have reproduced the previous cipher rune. That validity test is exact for encipher_keyskip and for nothing else, so constructions that desynchronise the key for any other reason are excluded by the decoder's transition relation rather than merely being harder for it.
A load-bearing headline statistic is miscounted (a second, independent re-derivation of R12-D2 with fresh code).

The G3 doublet-deficit floor - min_d Pdp(d) > 0.664% for real plaintexts, therefore the key must be output-aware - is measured on four MODERN ENGLISH corpora only, and is English-conditional in the same way the scorer is.
benchmark/null.py's threshold_for() is a validated bar wherever the repo has used it.
RECON-B item B-17: the multiple-comparisons tally is frozen at 5 across Rounds 8-9.

Every load-bearing statistic in this repo is computed from the pinned 12,956-rune stream, but nobody has measured how sensitive any of them is to the transcription. Perturb the stream by k runes and recompute, so that T1's and T2's re-read has a price.

The 450 located O/A/AE disagreements (RECON-A item A-02, RECON-B item B-13) can be placed in 12,956-rune stream coordinates, making them a directly testable finite object rather than a glyph-index list.

The repo's ~10^10 sweep negatives are properties of a DECODE of this exact ciphertext, not of a summary statistic, so they inherit a different and steeper transcription-sensitivity curve than the doublet rate does.
